## Où j'en suis
The pg17 blue/green Terraform work for the analytics RDS is done for staging: parameter group family derived from the major version, `blue_green_update` on the instance, staging moved to 17.2, prod prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false`. AWS provider pinned to `~> 5.82.0`, tflint clean, plan-only (staging: 1 to add, 1 to change; prod: no changes), and draft PR #57 is open with the pg_partman and dbt-lock caveats in the description. Nothing has been applied to any database.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #57 (kestrel-analytics/infra) on branch `noa/rds-pg17`, awaiting review
- [prochaine-étape] On staging 16.4, run `ALTER EXTENSION pg_partman UPDATE TO '5.1.0'` and check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` / `events_daily` before any switchover
- [prochaine-étape] Get Maya's sign-off, then pick a prod window outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock on `events_daily` (candidates: Sat or Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC)
- [essai-raté] `terraform init -upgrade` pulled provider v6, whose breaking changes (S3 ACL, `aws_eip.vpc`) exploded the plan to 37 changes; reverted to 5.82
- [décision] AWS provider stays pinned to `~> 5.82.0`, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] pg_partman upgrade is a separate todo, nothing run against the DB (source: t10)
- [décision] No prod date and `apply_immediately = false` until Maya signs off (source: t14)
